.engramdb/memories/tax-uses-round-half-even_01a0f9f5-ae5e-7cf2-890b-237e4bfa3234.md:15:Tax amounts are rounded with banker's rounding (`decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), as decided with the finance team in March 2026. Do not use ROUND_HALF_UP.

Tax uses **banker's rounding**, `decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. The project's EngramDB memory records this as a decision made with the finance team in March 2026. It says not to use `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

I couldn't confirm it in the code. A search for `ROUND_`, `quantize` and `round(` found no rounding code in the repo, only the memory file itself. This answer rests on that memory alone.
